method: Build a clean protected telemetry archive from the exact firmware source pair above with tools/esphome/build_archive.py --expected-library-revision LIBRARY_SHA --oscore --telemetry; verify the archive and firmware hashes before each OTA installation.

Preserve existing pairwise credentials, management credentials and original firmware. Reuse the authoritative durable OSCORE state without reset; install an explicit qualification principal/resource binding on both endpoints.
Run telemetry-service provision-journal to create a new host journal. Verify repeat provisioning refuses and leaves existing security state unchanged.

Install firmware with telemetry.provision_pending to save one unique operation ID and complete 1024-byte body offline. Remove provision_pending and install normal telemetry firmware using the same archive. Normal firmware contains neither operation ID nor body.

Run telemetry-service serve with drop-first-receipt, a 90000 ms deadline and 180000 poll limit. Require one admitted exact operation, one durable effect, one intentionally withheld receipt and no transmitted receipt. Retain the journal snapshot after process exit.
Request device software restart through its encrypted ESPHome API. Independently capture the restart log and reset task counter for the installed run ID before accepting recovery evidence.

Start a fresh telemetry-service process against the same security file and journal, with a 35000 ms deadline and 70000 poll limit. Require the same operation ID and complete body, the original receipt, exactly one effect and a byte-identical journal. Capture COAPTIC_TELEMETRY_COMPLETE from the restarted device.
Preserve raw evidence privately. Update only the reserved device saved configuration to the verified normal telemetry archive; remove the temporary program/address-scoped UDP firewall rule.
setup_and_failure_evidence: Initial inbound LAN probe timed out before Windows administrator approval of a temporary UDP rule. That timeout was not treated as an authenticated protocol result.
The first application receipt was deliberately withheld after the effect and receipt journal were durable; recovery used a fresh host process.
The offline provisioning one-shot boot log was missed. Subsequent exact authenticated operation recovery established retained ID/body, rather than a claimed observed provisioning log.
The restarted client retried while the fresh host process was not yet listening.
Repeated host journal provisioning refused without changing authoritative security state.
limitations: manual caller-installed binding, no enrollment/current-policy authority
software restart only, no flash power-loss or hostile snapshot rollback
ESP32-S3 is qualification platform, not portable-core dependency
production entropy/key custody and full HA/Taldra end-user flow unproven
offline provisioning one-shot boot log was missed by API capture; retained operation was confirmed by subsequent exact authenticated body and ID recovery
task stack observation includes adapter/runtime initialization and is not a whole-device memory ceiling or performance comparison
client retried while the fresh host process was not yet listening before receipt recovery
One operation on one device and LAN; no sustained availability, routed-network, throughput, independent protected-stack hardware or additional-MCU qualification.
No physical third-boot proof of cached completion without traffic; that behavior has host/unit coverage.
Build preparation runtime_passed fields remain false because compilation alone did not prove execution; physical conclusions derive from the separate host/API records.
